Rain gauge reference

Calibration

Adjust the dial until the reference reads 12 millimetres. Record the reading with the instrument level on a flat surface.

Maintenance

Replace the inlet filter after six sampling cycles. Inspect the gasket during each replacement and record any visible cracks.
